Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art animation sprite atlas for Paco, a tiny desktop companion.
Image 1 is the approved character identity/style reference only. Author NEW sequential animation drawings, not a pasted version of that pose sheet.
OUTPUT: exactly 1024 by 1024 PNG with a REAL TRANSPARENT alpha background. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal 256x256 cells, 16 full-body figures total, no text or cell borders. One figure per cell, wholly inside its cell with transparent padding. Every figure has the same head size and consistent anatomy/proportions, centered on local x=128, ground line y=232. Standing height about 208 pixels. Seated height about 150 pixels; do not enlarge seated figures to fill cell. All views face RIGHT in a three-quarter side view unless the brief explicitly says front.
Paco is a short round heavy older middle-aged man, balding head with gray side hair, full gray beard, exposed round belly, royal-blue tracksuit with white stripes and blue-white trainers. Friendly willing determined expression, visibly out of breath but not frightened or sad. Large readable pixel clusters, dark stepped outline, simplified palette, crisp game pixel art that reads at 128x128. No soft painterly shading, no floor shadow, no glow or backdrop, NO checkerboard drawn into the image.
Each row is an exact left-to-right animation:
ROW 1 seated idle loop: frame 0 seated resting with both hands by knees, friendly tired face; frame 1 lifts his right hand halfway toward brow; frame 2 wipes brow with forearm, two small sweat droplets attached near forehead; frame 3 lowers hand halfway. Keep seated body, shoes and head placement almost unchanged throughout this row.
ROW 2 four-frame RUN CYCLE traveling right in place: frame 4 right foot leading left trailing and arms opposite; frame 5 passing pose feet close under belly, body 3 pixels lower; frame 6 LEFT foot leading and right trailing, opposite arm swing; frame 7 second passing pose. Distinct alternating leg/arm contacts, preserve belly size, friendly open panting mouth and raised relaxed eyebrows. No trail or background.
ROW 3 four consecutive STAND UP frames: frame 8 seated as frame0; frame9 leans forward with a hand on knee; frame10 half-standing with bent knees; frame11 standing upright. Feet share ground y232. Smooth progressive silhouettes, same character scale.
ROW 4: frame12 standing three-quarter facing right with head glancing toward viewer; frame13 standing FRONT view midway through a turn, feet planted (runtime will mirror when needed); frame14 seated dozing, hands relaxed, eyes softly closed and head dipped; frame15 same seated doze with a subtly deeper exhale and shoulders 2 pixels lower. Frame14/15 must differ subtly, with grounded feet identical.
Preserve his warm beard/face and exact blue-white costume in all 16 cells. Uniform cell registration and transparent negative space matter more than extra detail. No writing, numbers, guides, labels, logos, furniture, towel, decorative shadow, duplicate extra people or animation arrows. Real alpha transparency outside every sprite.
correction: Edit this 16-frame Paco animation atlas. Preserve the character identity, pixel style, blue/white tracksuit, round belly, gray beard, all sixteen cell assignments and genuine alpha transparency. Make just the following production corrections: 1) On the second row, the THIRD character must be the opposite contact of the FIRST: his LEFT leg reaches forward toward the right, RIGHT leg bent behind toward the left, and left arm backward/right arm forward. The run cycle must alternate limbs, not repeat the first stride. Keep facing right. 2) Increase clear transparent gutters between all rows/columns: use four columns and four rows of equal cells on a square sheet, with every character fully inside its own cell, at least 12 pixels of real transparent margin on every cell edge, no cropped shoes. Maintain consistent character scale across all sixteen drawings, with sitting poses physically shorter than standing. Do not stretch seated heads or torsos. 3) Clean alpha silhouettes: remove stray red/green/blue fringe pixels and stray marks completely. Outside the deliberate dark pixel-art outline everything is alpha zero, including the gutters; no floor shadows. Keep heads and feet intact. 4) The two sleeping poses at bottom right are a quiet breathing loop, so remove the white puff beside the last head; only subtle shoulders/belly breathing. No new writing, boxes, labels, checkerboard, backdrop, or added characters. Output a square PNG with genuine transparent alpha.

Head turned right with friendly panting smile, relaxed brows, huffing but willing; gray full beard, balding scalp gray side hair, short heavy round proportions, large exposed belly, royal blue tracksuit with white side stripes and blue-white trainers. Crisp stepped pixel-art clusters, dark outline, simple readable 128-pixel sprite design. No floor shadow or ground, no text, no props, no motion trails. Full figure centered with ample transparent padding, all shoes and hands intact. Preserve exactly the costume colors and friendly older character identity. PNG with actual transparency, no checkerboard painted in.
